project_info.color_palette: Techcombank red, white, light beige, black

main_subject.detail: A clean red-and-white reward-hunt poster with Techcombank OneU branding. Large headline says 'Thong bao TIM NGUOI'. A giant red ticket-shaped board holds two rounded white checklist bubbles. The first bubble reads 'Uong Phuc Long, Highlands, Starbucks & cac quan cafe khac... moi ngay' with an iced coffee image and a green check icon. The second bubble reads 'Da thanh toan qua QR cua hang Techcombank' with a Techcombank QR stand image and another green check icon. Lower text on the red ticket says 'Nhung quen mo qua tu Techcombank', and a detached ticket note says 'Lum qua duoi comment lien!'. A wrapped Techcombank gift box sits on a red pedestal. Bottom-right badge says 'Da tang uu dai LOI ICH TOI UU'.
main_subject.style: Polished reward-promo graphic with 3D ticket-board layering, clean checklist UI, and retail gift-box styling
